text_block_list.text:
On that day,
I was visiting a certain hotel
with Rose Kingdom.

It was to taste-test the dishes to be
served
at the party hosted by Rose Kingdom.
choice_data_list: The tasting samples will be factor...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, forgive me for troubling you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This is an establishment with which my family
enjoys close ties,
so I have complete faith in both their
cuisine and service, yet—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As host,
I must confirm it with my own eyes and
palate.
I could hardly serve dishes whose flavors
I do not know.

Shortly thereafter,
a lavish spread of gourmet delicacies
was set before Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Magnificent.
A first-rate chef truly knows
how to feast the eyes as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This is sure to please our distinguished
guests as well.
choice_data_list: However... it does seem like quite...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I had every item from the day's menu
prepared in advance.
It is fully within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us partake without delay.
choice_data_list: Do you perhaps intend to eat all o...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. If I do not eat it all,
how else am I to determine whether the
portion was appropriate?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the circumstances,
we may need to consider changing the menu.
choice_data_list: Allow me to check the portion size.
Certainly. As you wish, Lady Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, indeed, you seem much closer
to the profile of an invited guest,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I leave it to you.
Let us divide them up for the tasting.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This, too,
is my duty as the representative of the
House of the Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over me,
that I may carry out my duty without fail.

And thus,
Rose Kingdom finished every last delicacy
with peerless elegance.
